grants: This stage grants the character a value arising from their career outlook.

lengths.name: Novice
lengths.description: Your character is defined by their potential more than their skill. Their raw talent and their expectations of what the universe is like has not yet been tempered by reality.
lengths.valuePrompt: Add a value, reflecting their inexperience and naïveté in some way.

lengths.name: Experienced
lengths.description: Your character has several years of experience and is enjoying a promising career.

lengths.name: Veteran
lengths.description: Your character has decades of experience and has served on many ships and starbases. Their judgement and opinions are highly regarded by subordinates, peers, and even superiors.
lengths.valuePrompt: Add a value, reflecting their years of experience and the beliefs they’ve formed over their long career.
